title: Figures 14-15: Fusion vs Nuclear-Thermal vs Chemical Propulsion; Thrust-to-Weight Regimes
description: Figure 14, 'Comparison of Fusion, Nuclear-Thermal, and Chemical Propulsion for Same Payload', has two bar charts for Earth-Mars missions: trip time in days at 29% payload, and payload fraction for a 258-day trip, comparing chemical (Isp=450 s), nuclear thermal (Isp=900 s), and fusion at 1 and 10 kW/kg. Figure 15, 'Thrust-to-Weight Ratio and Exhaust Velocity Regimes for Various Long-Range Space Propulsion Options', is a log-log chart of exhaust velocity (m/s) versus thrust-to-weight ratio with colored bands for fusion, nuclear (fission) electric, gas-core fission, nuclear thermal and chemical, and specific-power lines from 0.01 to 10 kW/kg.
